Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Isha - 12 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Sonali - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Suresh - 44 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Rishabh - 10 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Isha stands in the courtyard. Aarav, Sonali and Suresh stand near her.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Isha draws a rangoli at the door.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[Aarav draws a picture of the house.]

Sonali: "Good job, Aarav!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Sonali and Isha stand near him.]

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Isha (surprised): "What happened?"

[Aarav drinks a glass of water.]

Aarav (surprised): "Isha, look at this."

[Aarav gulps down a glass of milk.]

Isha: "Mom, look at this."

[Aarav serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Sonali: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Aarav: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav shouts angrily.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav stamps his foot in anger.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Aarav (excited): "I really enjoyed today."
